# Emigration Aid

> Expert visa and education consultancy based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Established in 2009 with 17+ years of experience, 500+ successful student placements, and 20+ destination countries.

## About

Emigration Aid (legally Jamal Associates & Emigration Aid) is a leading immigration and education consultancy headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Founded by Khan Abu Rawshan Md Mostofa Jamal in September 2009, the firm specializes in student recruitment, skilled immigration pathways, and end-to-end visa processing for individuals seeking to study or migrate abroad.

## Services

- **Student Recruitment & Placement**: University selection, course matching, application filing, and student visa preparation for 20+ countries.
- **Skilled Immigration**: Permanent residency pathway mapping, credential assessment (ECA), Express Entry profiling, and job placement assistance.
- **One-on-One Counseling**: Personalized sessions covering career goals, scholarship matching, financial auditing, and visa roadmaps.
- **Pre-Departure Briefings**: Flight orientation, health coverage setup, international banking, and safety guidelines.
- **Post-Arrival Assistance**: Airport pickup coordination, housing shortlists, and part-time job mentoring.

## Destination Countries

Australia, New Zealand, Canada, United Kingdom, United States, Hungary, France, Germany, Finland, Sweden, Malta, and other European nations.
